titulo: The book opened to page forty-two
caption:
The book opened to page forty-two

The book was closed. She opened it, turned three pages and left a gold tab on page forty-two.

A book left open at the right page saves the next reader the hunt, and they start reading at once.

For whoever opens the book to the page the next person needs.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a closed teal book standing up. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the book opens, three pages turn one after another and a gold tab that says p. 42 pops onto the top of the page, with a small sparkle. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me opening it to their page.
